result.rationale: The new webhook handler calls appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body) and symmetricDecrypt/JSON.parse with no try/catch; the diff shows no error middleware for this route, so malformed input or bad encryption key throws and yields an unhandled 500 rather than a 4xx. That is incorrect behavior for a newly added API endpoint (though it is an error-handling robustness issue, not data corruption), so bug at moderate confidence.

judged_text: The webhook handler has no error handling around `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)`, `symmetricDecrypt(...)`, or `JSON.parse(...)` — a malformed body, wrong encryption key, or invalid ciphertext throws an unhandled ZodError/crypto error and the route returns a 500. Any misconfigured or malformed sync push from the parent cal.com gets a 500 instead of a 4xx, and operators get no diagnostic signal distinguishing a bad key from a bad payload; retries from the parent will keep failing identically.
